name: suayptalha/wsr
title: Weight-space reading predicts edits without a forward pass
summary: A reader model inspects the raw weights of 9B to 30B models with Python and predicts how small edits will change math accuracy, reasoning length, and refusal, without running the edited model. On subtle edits, Qwen3.8-27B reaches 73% balanced accuracy, versus 57.8% from a text description of the same edits.

appearances.title: Weight-space reading predicts edit effects without running the model
appearances.summary: Weight-space reading lets a language model inspect raw weights with Python and predict how a small edit will change math accuracy, reasoning length, and refusal, without a forward pass on the edited model. Qwen3.8-27B reaches 73% balanced accuracy on subtle edits, versus 57.8% from a text description alone, but readers also flag changes for most edits that leave Muse-30B's behavior unchanged.
